content:
kevin: quick heads-up — found a 404 in the runtime guide (kv-cache prefetch image) — https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache#prefetch
kevin: quick curl check: 
```
$ curl -I https://cdn.redwood.ai/images/kv-prefetch.png
HTTP/2 404
```
maria: ugh, thanks for flagging. i can open a tiny PR to rehost the asset under /static if that's easiest
sam: do we know who owns that page? @docs-bot any owner metadata for that doc?
docs-bot: Page metadata: owners: team-runtime; last_edit: 2025-11-02; path: content/runtime/kv-cache.md
lee: if it's a missing CDN asset i usually rehost under /static and update the markdown. sed helps: 
```
git checkout -b fix/docs/kv-prefetch
# replace url in the doc
git apply <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: content/runtime/kv-cache.md
@@
-![prefetch diagram](https://cdn.redwood.ai/images/kv-prefetch.png)
+![prefetch diagram](/static/images/kv-prefetch.png)
*** End Patch
PATCH
```
maria: i'll take that branch and open the PR. pinging @sam for review once it's up
sam: can do a review tomorrow morning, prefer we also add a small redirect in case older links still hit the old CDN
carla: also please add alt text and a short caption — linter complained on similar fixes before
kevin: happy to add a tiny linkcheck tweak too. one-liner to verify: 
```
scripts/linkcheck --include /static/images/kv-prefetch.png
```
maria: opening PR now — branch: fix/docs/kv-prefetch; title: "docs: rehost kv prefetch diagram and update link"
maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3491
sam: added review request. :eyes:
kevin: i pushed a tiny CI job tweak to run the linkcheck for /static on each deploy, should catch this next time
carla: :thumbsup: thanks y'all
maria: will merge after sam lgtm and then i can follow up with a redirect if the CDN still serves 404s
kevin: thanks — nice quick win for docs health
